}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== OEM SerComm (WW00A-1.6MM main board, Y200A-1.0MM (or something similar) wireless module)
Per the manual, the default SSID is '''NETGEAR'''.
===Specifications=== *CPU: [[Broadcom]] BCM6348KPB • ADSL2+ CPE, Single-Chip, Transceiver and AFE *Flash: [[Macronix]] MX29LV320ABTC-90 • 4MB (32Mb, 4Mx8bits), 70ns, 3V *RAM: [[SK hynix]] HY57V283220(L)T(P)-7 • 16MB (128Mb, 4Banksx1Mx32bit), 3.3V, 143MHz *WLAN: Atheros AR5005GS Wireless Mini PCI Card :[[Atheros]] AR2414 • Single-Chip CMOS MAC/Baseband/Radio *Ethernet Switch: [[Broadcom]] BCM5325EKQM • 5-Port, 10/100
